radiation._about: Solar particle event rules. The storm rate itself is REAL (src/data/real/radlab_sep.json). shelterAboveUGyPerHour and unshelteredDamagePerHour are GAME RULES (not a medical model); NASA-STD-3001 only says to alert the crew and shelter them (250 mSv per-event limit).

shelter._about: Storm shelter alcove in Personal: only a head inside the alcove counts as sheltered (crew:shelter). Water-wall shelters are a real design (ISS crew quarters, Orion). Sizes in metres.
